item: markdown follow-ups (backlog #33, #34, #35; register 1.11 / 1.12): indented code blocks, inline code opaque to emphasis, fence placeholders that never print and ~~~ fences
branch: inlineMd (code-span tokens), the fence lift and CB_LINE in mdBlocks, the indented-code branch in mdBlocks — all in 20-markdown.js; codeBlockHtml is the one builder for fenced and indented code
provenance: Renderer-only: each case hands a markdown SOURCE string to renderMd and compares the HTML (code-block header and highlight spans stripped). The shapes are CommonMark's; '2. … / 7-space-indented line' is the user's 2026-09-09 sighting, '-*+' is fixture 86's plan text, 'text ```x``` more' is fixture 85's finding. No wire frame is claimed. NEGATIVE CONTROL computed in Node against HEAD's 20-markdown.js before the sandbox run: 15 of 23 cases differ (marked DISCRIMINATING), 8 are guards equal on both builds SANDBOX CONTROL RUN 2026-11-22 against HEAD's whole webview directory (c5a14b5): 15 FAILED / 8 passed — the same split Node computed; 23/23 after the change.
